faqPage.subtitle: Direct answers regarding pricing, KFPS papers, training levels and shipping.

items.q: How much does a Friesian cost?
items.a: It depends on its training level, height, age and awards. We share the price of each horse on WhatsApp the same day; it is the same for every client.

items.q: How do I know it is purebred?
items.a: By its papers: it is registered with the KFPS, the Dutch breed registry, with an original passport and verified pedigree.

items.q: Can it perform dancing / high school movements?
items.a: Yes, if trained for it. Each horse's profile states its level and you can see how it moves in its video. We have ridden horses as well as colts ready to be trained your way.

items.q: Can I see the pedigree before visiting?
items.a: Yes. We send the registration, pedigree and a photo of the passport by message.

items.q: Do white, pinto or chestnut Friesians exist?
items.a: Not in the KFPS: it only registers black horses; the only white marking permitted is a small star on the forehead.

Most of our horses are imported from the Netherlands and hand-selected one by one; their passport states where they were born. We also have Mexican-born Friesians, clearly indicated as such on their profile.

items.q: Can all of them be ridden?
items.a: No. Horses trained under saddle are ridden; colts and those just starting under saddle are presented in hand. Each profile states its level.
It varies. Each profile lists the height at the withers.

items.q: Do you ship to other states or countries?
items.a: Yes, throughout Mexico, the United States and Latin America. We provide a quote with no obligation.
No. We hand-select each horse in the Netherlands and keep them in Zapotlanejo so you can meet them in person.

stablePage.p1: In Zapotlanejo, Jalisco, 38 minutes from Guadalajara, Cuadra Imperial Loy is dedicated to one thing only: bringing Friesians of noble carriage, personally selected in the Netherlands.
stablePage.p2: We do not import in bulk. We travel to the Netherlands to see each horse ridden, walked and evaluated for temperament. Every horse arrives with its original KFPS passport and registration.
stablePage.predicatesIntro: The Koninklijke Vereniging 'Het Friesch Paarden-Stamboek' (KFPS), founded in 1879 in the Netherlands, evaluates the conformation, movement and aptitude of every Friesian through official inspections (Keuring).

predicatesTable.meaning: Registration in the Foal Book (Veulenboek) and subsequent entry into the Main Studbook (Stamboek) upon adult inspection.
Recognition awarded at official KFPS inspections according to adherence to the breed standard in conformation, walk and trot.
Predicate awarded to horses that stand out for conformation, minimum required height and superior quality of movement at the walk and trot.
Higher distinctions for mares combining excellent conformation with performance testing (IBOP or ABFP).
Predicate awarded for proven results in official dressage or driving competition.
Recognition of quality demonstrated through registered KFPS offspring.

sections.title: 1. Data Controller
sections.body: Cuadra Imperial Loy, located in Zapotlanejo, Jalisco, Mexico, with official email info@cuadraimperialloy.com, is responsible for the use and protection of your personal data in accordance with the Federal Law on Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties (LFPDPPP).

sections.title: 2. Data Collected & Purpose
sections.body: We collect only the information you voluntarily provide (name, WhatsApp number, ranch city/location, and horses of interest) to log your inquiry in our internal administrative system, assign a reference folio, share horse documentation, coordinate private visits in Zapotlanejo, and quote shipping or breeding services.

sections.title: 3. Data Retention & Confidentiality
sections.body: Your data is stored under restricted access controls in our internal system to follow up on your inquiry. We never sell or transfer your personal data to third parties.

sections.title: 4. ARCO Rights (Access, Rectification, Cancellation & Opposition)
sections.body: You may request access, rectification, cancellation or deletion of your personal data at any time by messaging info@cuadraimperialloy.com or our official WhatsApp +52 33 1702 6066 with your name or reference folio.

sections.title: 1. Informational Nature of the Catalog
sections.body: This website is intended solely to present the Friesian horses of Cuadra Imperial Loy and facilitate direct communication via WhatsApp or private visit requests in Zapotlanejo, Jalisco. No listing constitutes an automated online checkout offer.

sections.title: 2. Pricing & Availability
sections.body: Horse prices are provided directly through our official WhatsApp channel (+52 33 1702 6066) and are the same for every client. Availability of each horse is confirmed upon executing a purchase agreement.

sections.title: 3. Purchase Agreement & Veterinary Inspection
sections.body: Every sale is formalized through a written purchase agreement, reservation deposit, and final payment subject to veterinary inspection prior to delivery.
